mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT table_name) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('tb_plan', 'tb_plan_feature', 'tb_tenant_subscription')

SELECT p.plan_code FROM tb_tenant_subscription s JOIN tb_plan p ON p.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.subscription_status = #{subscriptionStatus} AND s.starts_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (s.ends_at IS NULL OR s.ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY s.starts_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT tenant_id FROM tb_tenant WHERE tenant_code = #{value} LIMIT 1

SELECT pf.feature_code AS featureCode, pf.enabled_at AS enabledAt FROM tb_tenant_subscription s JOIN tb_plan_feature pf ON pf.plan_id = s.plan_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.subscription_status = #{subscriptionStatus} AND s.starts_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (s.ends_at IS NULL OR s.ends_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY pf.feature_code

SELECT p.plan_code AS planCode, p.plan_nm AS planName, p.plan_desc AS planDesc, p.use_at AS useAt, COUNT(DISTINCT pf.plan_feature_id) AS featureCount, COUNT(DISTINCT pm.plan_menu_id) AS menuCount FROM tb_plan p LEFT JOIN tb_plan_feature pf ON pf.plan_id = p.plan_id LEFT JOIN tb_plan_menu pm ON pm.plan_id = p.plan_id AND pm.use_at = 'Y' GROUP BY p.plan_code, p.plan_nm, p.plan_desc, p.use_at ORDER BY p.plan_code
SELECT pf.feature_code AS featureCode, pf.enabled_at AS enabledAt FROM tb_plan p JOIN tb_plan_feature pf ON pf.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE p.plan_code = #{value} ORDER BY pf.feature_code

SELECT pf.feature_code AS featureCode, pf.feature_nm AS featureName, pf.feature_type AS featureType, pf.enabled_at AS enabledAt, pf.limit_value AS limitValue FROM tb_plan p JOIN tb_plan_feature pf ON pf.plan_id = p.plan_id WHERE p.plan_code = #{value} ORDER BY pf.feature_code
SELECT pm.menu_code FROM tb_plan_menu pm JOIN tb_plan p ON p.plan_id = pm.plan_id WHERE p.plan_code = #{value} AND pm.use_at = 'Y' ORDER BY pm.menu_code
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_plan_menu pm USING tb_plan p WHERE pm.plan_id = p.plan_id AND p.plan_code = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_plan_menu (plan_id, menu_code, use_at, created_at, updated_at) SELECT p.plan_id, #{menuCode}, 'Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tb_plan p WHERE p.plan_code = #{planCode} ON CONFLICT (plan_id, menu_code) DO UPDATE SET use_at = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_user WHERE tenant_id = #{value} AND use_at = 'Y'
